test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 03 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Rupin, Sunny, Guddu, Shradha, Naveen and Rahul are sitting around a circular table facing each other and sitting opposite to each other. Rupin is between Naveen and Rahul. Naveen is opposite Shradha. Guddu is not the immediate neighbour of Naveen. Who is opposite to Sunny?
solution:
**Given:** Rupin, Sunny, Guddu, Shradha, Naveen and Rahul are sitting around a circular table facing each other and sitting opposite to each other. 

1) Naveen is opposite Shradha. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6157ca38b77218b0199d8d28b1b85006b41c1be02f6e49a3d1f086c54cbe42ff.png] 

2) Rupin is between Naveen and Rahul.

As position of Rupin with respect to Naveen is not known yet, therefore there are two possible cases.

Case 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d0ac0d4c02e35a31474a8aa6ffa23bbe1f0b8898a935158f771928d9ce32bf1.png] 

Case 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d5c45e49084e438516e2ceec79d75db7a048c976bd35bcf02a0a89906aac7d8.png] 

3) Guddu is not the immediate neighbour of Naveen.

After positioning Guddu, only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Sunny.

Case 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a8dbe23c2457bc4d61a8829864d18be3a496b6a591db459ef163d2f08111fd4.png] 

Case 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75060a7d4cf639d3e1635af698f11856a1c0576c0a6b4837561671c4c029203b.png] 

Thus, in both the cases, Rahul is opposite to Sunny.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
